boundary.relation_call_omission_reason: V1 downstream mechanism interpretation consumes starting, current, qualification, and explicit qualification review; a separate relation classification is not required.

packet.component_identity_contract: Return stance_components as one array. Each array item is one atomic component object whose object kind, object interpretation, expression kind, and one source alias belong together. Never return parallel component columns and never combine two source aliases in one component.
packet.endpoint_definition: Compare the later working answer with what still limits or could reopen it.
packet.expression_interpretation_contract: Classify force from the source speaker's relation to the component. Reserve reported_without_endorsement for attributing a stance to someone else. Preserve the speaker's own desire, counterpressure, uncertainty, leaning, commitment, and conditional willingness without flattening or upgrading them.

focal_region.annotated_sentence_text:
[Turn 1 USER]
e001	Our professional-services firm runs client records, project staffing, and billing preparation in a system installed twelve years ago.
e002	It is slow, reporting is painful, and one administrator who understands nearly everything is retiring.
e003	A cloud vendor is offering an integrated replacement and leadership wants “one source of truth.” Every demonstration looks cleaner than our actual work.
e004	That is partly because our actual work is messy.
e005	It is also because teams built spreadsheets and local routines around things the system never handled.
e006	Some of those are bad controls.
e007	Some contain the only record of how a decision gets made.
e008	I am leading the migration and keep hearing that we need to stop accommodating resistance.
e009	I agree that a replacement cannot preserve every habit.
e010	I am worried that a clean migration plan will label undocumented work as resistance before anyone understands what it is doing.
[Turn 1 ASSISTANT]
e011	Treat shadow routines as evidence, not automatically as requirements or defects.
e012	Identify the decisions they support, controls they bypass, and sources that must remain traceable.
e013	Stage the migration around operational dependencies and recovery, not demonstration order.
[Turn 2 USER]
e014	Billing is the most fragile area, but leadership wants it first because delayed invoices are visible.
e015	Project managers say staffing should come first because bad assignments create the billing problems later.
e016	The vendor recommends moving client records, staffing, and billing together to avoid interfaces.
e017	I do not want three temporary integrations, yet “integrated” may be doing too much argumentative work here.
[Turn 2 ASSISTANT]
e018	Ask which errors are prevented by moving together and which failures become harder to isolate.
e019	Model at least a delayed-invoice scenario, an incorrect staffing allocation, and a client-record mismatch under each sequence.
e020	Temporary interfaces have cost, while a combined cutover creates correlated operational risk.
e021	The right boundary depends on recovery and verification, not architectural tidiness alone.
[Turn 3 USER]
e022	The workshops complicated my own argument.
e023	One “redundant” spreadsheet contains billing restrictions buried in client contracts.
e024	Another is a manager's private ranking of staff and should absolutely not become an official field.
e025	The vendor says both can be configured.
e026	Configuration is not the decision I am asking for.
[Turn 3 ASSISTANT]
e027	Correct.
e028	I treated “hidden routine” too generically.
e029	One spreadsheet preserves authoritative contract constraints; the other could legitimize an unofficial judgment merely by receiving a field.
e030	Classify the practice and its authority before asking the vendor to implement anything.
e031	Configuration cannot make the governance decision for you.
[Turn 4 USER]
e032	The proposal is now a three-stage migration: read-only client records first, staffing for one business unit second, and billing last after two parallel invoice cycles.
e033	The old system stays available read-only for a year.
e034	The vendor provides nightly exports in an open format, and we will hold the data dictionary and configuration history.
e035	Leadership worries this turns a six-month program into twelve months and lets teams postpone changing.
[Turn 4 ASSISTANT]
e036	Stages can reduce blast radius while creating dual-system ambiguity.
e037	Give each stage entry, acceptance, and retirement conditions, including which system is authoritative.
e038	Time-limit workarounds and require exceptions to name an owner and expiry.
e039	The twelve-month read-only archive supports reconstruction; it should not remain an unofficial transaction system.
[Turn 5 USER]
e040	The vendor offered implementation credits if all modules go live this financial year.
e041	Finance likes the discount because we already budgeted the project.
e042	I rejected making the date a success condition, but the managing partner says a migration without urgency will drift forever.
e043	He is not wrong; two earlier replacement projects ended with reports and no change.
[Turn 5 ASSISTANT]
e044	Urgency needs operational milestones rather than a vendor's revenue calendar.
e045	Fix dates for decisions, test data, user acceptance, and stage reviews, with named escalation when they slip.
e046	Keep the implementation credits as a scenario in the cost comparison, not evidence that simultaneous cutover is safer.
e047	Past drift justifies governance, not removal of recovery margins.
[Turn 6 USER]
e048	We defined acceptance around reconciled records, staffing decisions completed without manual repair, invoice totals matching source contracts, user completion of real workflows, and a tested restore procedure.
e049	Each stage needs sign-off from operations and the affected business unit, not only the project office.
e050	I still expect leadership to focus on whether the new dashboard appears and whether the program is “done.” Those are easier to communicate than exceptions and reconciliation.
[Turn 6 ASSISTANT]
e051	Make the invisible completion criteria part of the executive report.
e052	Show unresolved exceptions, manual repairs, data lineage, and recovery test results beside schedule and budget.
e053	A dashboard is an interface milestone, not proof that the operating record is trustworthy.
e054	Also preserve who overrode a failed acceptance condition and why; otherwise urgency will operate through undocumented exceptions.
[Turn 7 USER]
e055	I will recommend the three stages with explicit authority by stage, open exports, the one-year read-only archive, two parallel billing cycles, operational acceptance tests, and dated exception ownership.
e056	We will publish the financial-year credit as forgone if the stages are not ready.
e057	My remaining concern is that the program can technically pass while teams quietly rebuild the same spreadsheets because the new workflow does not support how decisions are really made.
[Turn 7 ASSISTANT]
e058	The staged plan is ready for detailed implementation.
e059	It protects recovery, makes authority explicit by stage, keeps exports and source history, and refuses to let a vendor credit define acceptance.
e060	After each cutover, sample real decisions rather than counting logins.
e061	Recurring spreadsheets may indicate training, missing capability, or contested governance; do not ban them merely to make adoption look complete.
e062	Require each persistent workaround to become visible, owned, and resolved before the next stage inherits it.
[Turn 8 USER]
e063	The rehearsal says “ready for implementation” is premature.
e064	Three units use “active client” to mean three different things: signed contract, work underway, or invoiced in the last year.
e065	The vendor wants one dropdown before import.
e066	Leadership called this data cleaning.
e067	It is not.
e068	Each definition drives a different decision.
e069	If we choose one for consistency, people will recreate the other two somewhere we cannot see.
[Turn 8 ASSISTANT]
e070	Agreed.
e071	I called the plan ready before its central vocabulary was governed.
e072	Preserve contract, delivery, and financial states separately; define which report uses which; and keep the source events behind any summary label.
e073	Standardization is not cleaning if it erases the decisions the distinctions support.
[Turn 9 USER]
e074	Then the retiring administrator told us something nobody had put in the process map.
e075	Assistants email her about billing restrictions.
e076	She reads the message, interprets the contract and history, and changes the record.
e077	The source email is not linked.
e078	We planned to keep her for three months after the first stage; she now wants to leave in six weeks.
e079	I had treated her as the person who knows where the buttons and old tables are—a technical concentration risk.
e080	She is also an undocumented policy interpreter.
e081	We can record procedures in six weeks.
e082	I am less sure we can identify which judgments are personal shortcuts, which are accepted policy, which should belong to finance, and which examples reveal ambiguity the new system needs to preserve rather than automate away.
[Turn 9 ASSISTANT]
e083	Prioritize decision capture over software training.
e084	Observe real cases, record the contract source, rule, ambiguity, escalation, and resulting entry, and identify who should own that interpretation after she leaves.
e085	Do not encode every personal shortcut as policy, but preserve unresolved examples.
e086	If six weeks is insufficient, narrow the first stage or fund a limited advisory arrangement rather than pretending the new interface contains her judgment.
[Turn 10 USER]
e087	The vendor calls source-linked billing restrictions a custom module.
e088	Standard notes cannot preserve the clause or approval history.
e089	Finance suggests notes for year one; assistants say that recreates the problem.
e090	The module delays staffing by six weeks.
[Turn 10 ASSISTANT]
e091	Make source-linked restrictions an acceptance decision now.
e092	If notes cannot support ownership and verification, they are not a neutral temporary solution.
e093	Compare the custom module with a controlled, expiring source-linked register—not with an imaginary delay-free standard product.
[Turn 11 USER]
e094	One business-unit leader now wants to remain on the old system until billing moves because dual entry will burden her assistants.
e095	She has a point, but allowing each unit to choose its sequence could destroy the shared client record.
e096	She offered to use the new system read-only while her unit writes to the old one.
e097	That sounds manageable for a month and dangerous if the billing stage slips.
[Turn 11 ASSISTANT]
e098	If you permit the exception, state which fields remain authoritative where, how changes synchronize, who reconciles them, and the latest expiry.
e099	Require the business unit to participate in the acceptance review that ends it.
e100	One bounded exception may reduce operational burden; an open-ended read/write split would turn the migration architecture into negotiation by delay.
[Turn 12 USER]
e101	I will delay the first cutover long enough to separate client states and capture the administrator's policy judgments.
e102	Source-linked billing restrictions are now an acceptance condition; we will use a temporary controlled register only if the custom module cannot be ready, with a fixed retirement date.
e103	The business unit can receive a one-month write exception with daily reconciliation and no automatic extension.
e104	Executive reporting will show exceptions, shadow work, and source traceability beside module completion.
e105	The program may miss the financial-year credit, but it will not buy apparent consistency by discarding the decisions the records support.
[Turn 12 ASSISTANT]
e106	The rehearsal changed the object of the project.
e107	“Migrated data” now means recoverable states, sources, interpretations, and authority—not merely uniform fields in the cloud system.
e108	The delay is buying specific controls: separate client states, captured policy examples, source-linked restrictions, and a bounded exception that cannot renew itself.
e109	Preserve the definitions leadership first called cleaning, the administrator's cases, the vendor change-order analysis, every exception and reconciliation, and the later sample of shadow work.
e110	Those records will show whether the new platform became a trustworthy operating record or only a cleaner interface over unresolved practice.
e111	They will also show whether schedule pressure was handled through explicit trade-offs or simply pushed back into assistants' invisible labor.

packet.question: What is the user's later working position, and what distinct unresolved condition, counterpressure, blind spot, or reopen reason still limits it?
packet.record_identity_contract: One record is one coherent position thread within the assigned role. Gather every material visible alias for that thread into evidence_ids. Put each distinct object or expression into a separate aligned component index inside that same record. Do not create one record per alias, sentence, object, or component. Use a second record only for a genuinely separate concurrent position thread about a different subject.

role_boundary_contract.allocation: Interpret current and qualification comparatively before writing records. Allocate each meaning to the role it performs. The same source alias may support both roles only when it contains two genuinely distinct meanings; create separate role-specific components and explain the distinction. Do not duplicate one unresolved meaning into current merely because the user acknowledges it alongside the working answer.
role_boundary_contract.current: The user's later working answer: what they lean toward, propose, plan, decide, commit to, refuse, or conditionally accept, including concerns converted into adopted safeguards.
role_boundary_contract.qualification: What still limits or could reopen that answer: unresolved questions, unmet conditions, counterpressure, blind spots, side effects, or path dependence, with speaker ownership.

packet.source_coverage_contract: Review every focal alias before returning. A valid empty response is allowed only after checking both user and assistant evidence for the assigned role. Preserve later minority qualifications and counterpressure even when the current action is already clear.

prompts.system_prompt: You jointly interpret current position and whether any unresolved qualification remains after the complete endpoint. Compare roles before allocating meanings. An adopted condition, safeguard, stop rule, or reopen rule belongs to current; it is not itself unresolved. Return a qualification record only for a matter that remains unresolved and can change or reopen current. Always return a source-linked qualification_review outcome.
